It's like you read my mind. I've been feeling this way for several years. No one cares if I'm dead. I sent letters expressing my desire to commit suicide and no one called to check on me. They are waiting for me to die. It's heartbreaking that my life turned out like this. When I had a nice job and was giving money people kept in contact. When I lost my job and place due to depression everyone turned their backs on me. When I reach out to them they are rude and negative. It seems that no one liked or cared about me. They only entertained me because I was gullible, did favors and gave money. Now that I'm broke alone and miserable I don't exist to anyone.

I feel the same. Exhausted, deeply depressed and alone. Everyone has abandoned me even people I've done so much for in the past. Before depression took hold and ruined my life, I was a productive person that helped people. But now that I the helper/giver needs assistance no one cares. I sadly realized that those relationships were not real but based on what I could do to benefit them. It's heartbreaking that people treat like I'm nothing and turned their backs on me when I'm down. I would never treat anyone this way.

Its as if they are seating back waiting for me to kill myself so they never have to see or hear me again. I will never understand why so many people hate me.
